messages:
Maya: Hey team — final pass on the NebulaGrid case screenshots + logo credits. I uploaded the assets to Figma: https://figma.com/file/nebulagrid/case-assets. Need legal OK on brand attribution and the quote line before we publish. Can design confirm alt text and accessibility notes?

Samir: On it. I'll swap the dark logo to the white lockup on slide 3 and compress the hero PNGs. Will update figma by EOD. :wrench:

Danielle: Quick Q — NebulaGrid sent two logo variants, one with tagline. Which one do you want in the one-pager?

Maya: We should use the no-tagline primary mark for all marketing assets. Partner asked for the lockup in the downloadable kit only.

Leo: Draft alt text for the three screenshots:```Slide 1: NebulaGrid dashboard showing throughput graphs and model selection menu.
Slide 2: Dedicated GPU pool view with active jobs highlighted.
Slide 3: Integration flow diagram between Redwood Private and NebulaGrid hardware.```Can tweak if legal needs more specificity.

Ruth (Legal): Saw the files. Brand usage is fine with two conditions: 1) include this credit line under the assets: "NebulaGrid is a registered trademark of NebulaGrid Inc." 2) do not use the tagline variant in public collateral without partner written permission. Otherwise :white_check_mark:.

Maya: Thanks Ruth. Samir — can you add the credit line as a small footer on the PDF? Also add an entry in the release notes about partner approval process.

Samir: Yep will add footer and update the release notes doc.

design-bot: Accessibility check complete — contrast ratio for hero CTA meets AA, missing alt attribute flagged on slide 2 (fixed in figma draft 3).

Danielle: Updated figma and added the no-tagline PNGs in /assets/logos. Also left a comment for NebulaGrid to confirm the quote attribution.

Maya: Perfect. Can we get final confirmation from NebulaGrid and then schedule the joint announcement for next Tuesday? If partner confirms by Monday, we'll be good.

Ruth (Legal): Add a small clause in the partner co-marketing agreement: "Partner will have 48 hours to review and request edits to any partner-attributed quotes." I'm marking approved pending that clause.

Maya: Noted. I'll add the clause and ping NebulaGrid now. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
